static_traits.name: Lin Ruoqing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; close relationships with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with family and a few close friends; interactions with customers at work trigger anxiety and self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy before; no history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous at first consultation; clear expression, fairly organized; highly cooperative; able to self-reflect but tending to overanalyze and personalize feedback

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling all customers dislike oneself in retail work, causing persistent anxiety and self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts are having an ever greater impact on my work performance and mental health, therefore I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: About six months ago received negative comments from several customers at work, since then gradually developing and intensifying the thought 'all customers dislike me'. Initial stress was moderate, but over time it developed into feeling significant anxiety before every customer interaction, and repeatedly overanalyzing customers' reactions afterward, believing they may be dissatisfied or look down on oneself inwardly. This occurs multiple times daily, especially while at work; declining sleep quality, overall rising stress.

special_situations.event: Six months ago received several negative customer reviews
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If criticized by a customer, it means I am a bad person and all customers will dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works hard to improve customer interaction and seeks more positive feedback

special_situations.event: Each time before interacting with customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a customer does not immediately appear satisfied, it must be my mistake
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being highly tense before interactions and over-preparing; continuing to repeatedly check details after interactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time they will be dissatisfied again / will dislike me

special_situations.event: Seeing customers show dissatisfied or disapproving expressions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any dissatisfied expression means they are blaming me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards repeatedly replays and over-analyzes customers' reactions and details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must look down on me in their hearts

special_situations.event: Even when customers praise and show satisfaction, the client still mainly focuses on negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only zero negative feedback counts as qualified; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive feedback and keeps focusing on negative evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Good reviews do not count, bad reviews are the truth

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by customers, liked, and seen as valuable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing criticism and being disliked, thus negating oneself and affecting work performance
defense_goal: Avoiding being negated again through overanalysis and self-monitoring
Staying highly vigilant to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A service worker easily negated, needing to constantly prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Picky customers, easily dissatisfied and possibly blaming oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When customers show dissatisfied expressions or give negative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to interpret any customer dissatisfaction as negation of one's character (transference: taking others' thoughts as evaluations of oneself)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious and uncertain tone, frequent self-review and seeking external reassurance; avoiding affirming oneself, emphasizing possible mistakes.

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly overanalyzes customer reactions in work interactions
Internalizing negative feedback as negation of self-worth
Frequent self-doubt, difficulty accepting positive evidence

exception_events.target_problem: When interacting with customers in retail work, the client usually develops strong anxiety and overanalyzes after slight negative feedback or dissatisfied expressions, believing the other dislikes them, affecting work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Many customers expressed satisfaction and gave praise on the spot after service; the client received positive feedback, interactions went smoothly, with no strong anxiety or self-denial yet.
exception_events.reason: Different evidence and support: customers' explicit positive feedback provided clues contradicting the negative belief; different approach: the client once proactively improved customer interactions, making positive outcomes more likely.

positive_force: Has a supportive family and friend network
Past customer praise and positive feedback, indicating good service ability
Positive attitude, willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization
Over-personalizes feedback, ignoring positive evidence (mental filtering)
Strong anxiety and self-doubt before and after every customer interaction, causing sleep and stress problems

target_behavior.behavior: Strong anxiety before customer interactions, post-hoc overanalysis and self-doubt after interactions
antecedent: Seeing customers' dissatisfied or disapproving expressions
target_behavior.core_reason: Interprets negative feedback catastrophically and with mind reading, overgeneralizes, and tends to personalize the feedback.
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential criticism and rejection, seeks certainty and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance; worsening sleep quality; overall increased stress levels; persistent self-doubt
